meta.title: Protected paths
meta.description: Keeps production configuration out of agent tool calls. Register directories and files in groups under Settings → Protected paths (or on this plugin's page). Scope: calls that name, resolve to, or write a protected path are denied before they run; parent directories stay usable for listing, glob and grep with protected entries removed from the results; relative spellings are caught too; the profile patch file is protected; every denial is written to an audit file. Risk: policy-level protection, not operating-system isolation — shell commands that assemble a path from variables, symlink or 8.3 short-path spellings, wildcard expansion, and access through MCP, browser automation, or processes outside DSH are not covered; listing a parent directory can still show the protected directory name; turning protection off makes those paths visible again; the plugin never changes file permissions or encryption. Disclaimer: provided AS-IS with no warranty of any kind, express or implied, including no warranty of non-infringement; you assume all risk, and the author is not liable for over- or under-blocking, configuration choices, or any direct or indirect loss arising from exposed configuration. It is not a security product, access control system, or DLP solution and does not replace OS permissions or disk encryption. Uninstall if you disagree.
